198451: Hiroshi Yuuki, with the player name of Hiro, is a high school boy who loves to play virtual reality MMORPGs. When a game store manager named Reona Kisaragi forces him to buy the game Kiwame Quest, he soon discovers that it is not what it seems.
198452: He was Hiroshi's best friend in "Kiwame Quest" and worked as a farmer at an apple farm.
198453: She was the sister of Martin and the childhood friend of Hiro in "Kiwame Quest".
198454: Reona is the manager of the desolate game store Kisaragi. She is a beautiful woman with clear silver hair and a great sense of style, but she forcefully sells Hiroshi Yuuki the VRMMORPG game "Kiwame Quest".
198455: She works as an inquisitor in the City of Ted.
198456: Kaede is Hiroshi's younger sister in the real world.
210903: Ginji is one of the few real players in "Kiwame Quest".
210904: Tesla is one of the most powerful NPCs in "Kiwame Quest". He is the captain of the town guard in Ted and his nickname is "Thunder Tesla".
210905: Soichirou is a young city councilor with a promising future. He used to be an extremely skilled full-dive RPG gamer and he is the only player to have conquered the "Kiwame Quest". His player name is Kamui (カムイ).
